requirements.statement: Report multiple-drivers when a valid net has at least two output pins.
requirements.rationale: Expose conflicting declared pin drivers after structural and reference validation.

origin.excerpt: - `multiple-drivers`, subjects [net ID], when at least two member pins are outputs.

assumptions: Count distinct output pins, including multiple pins on one component.
non_goals: This does not simulate analog electrical behavior.

decisions.statement: Evaluate role findings only after validating pin references.
decisions.rationale: Keep malformed references from producing misleading design-rule findings.
decisions.revisit_when: The validation phase ordering contract changes.
